questions.stem: How can the reliability of sampling data be improved?

options.text: By taking only one sample from the best-looking area
By using the largest possible quadrat size
By taking many repeat samples and calculating the mean
By only sampling on sunny days

questions.explanation: Taking many repeat samples (replicates) and calculating the mean increases the reliability of the data. More samples reduce the effect of anomalous results and give a more accurate picture of the true population across the habitat.
